label: Higher after an unrewarded trial (more so late in episode), lower after rare-rewarded trials.
terms: (phase != D2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase != D2) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase != D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2)
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 28 sits near +0.9 early in the episode and falls steadily to about -0.6 by trial 90-99 (timing R^2 0.92). Beyond timing, at D1 and GO it is pushed up after an unrewarded previous trial, and the push grows with episode trial as the baseline falls. It is pushed down after a rare-rewarded trial (a2 S1 r is lowest, a1 S2 r next). At D2 it is slightly higher when S2 is reached. The free fit adds an asymmetry for S1 outcomes (a1 S1 u raises it most; a2 S1 u and a1 S1 r are near neutral) plus a small belief_lo term (higher when S1 is believed good). Late-episode windows show slow drifts over runs of consecutive rewards that neither form captures. Only observed variables are used.
